tasks.task: Turn pasted documents into one import-ready CSV

items.when: When invoices, receipts, forms or order emails must become rows in the client's columns
When a new batch arrives and you need the steps from intake to a checked import
When the source is a PDF and its tables must come out intact before you map them
When the source is a scan or photo and needs text with page positions first
Before the file is handed over, to prove the rows match their source documents

tasks.task: Turn supplier invoices into a bills import file

items.when: When a batch of supplier invoices must become a file for the accounting bills import
When invoices should be matched to purchase orders and given suggested account codes
When each bill needs a code and a match, with a payment run left for approval
When every line and total must be recalculated and missing fields or bad dates listed
When the batch needs a matched register and a list of amounts to investigate
When the same suppliers recur, to track new exceptions and those resolved with evidence

tasks.task: Enter receipts and expenses for the bookkeeper

items.when: When loose receipts must become a categorised file with gaps and a reconciliation
When a receipt is a phone photo and the text must be read before entry
When each transaction needs a category, department and tax treatment
When the batch should end as a report with totals by category and gaps to fix

tasks.task: Turn business cards into a CRM contacts file

items.when: After an event, when cards typed or scanned to text must become CRM contacts
When the contacts must fit the CRM's import template field by field
When cards miss company size, industry or job title and the CRM needs them
Before upload, to catch duplicates of existing contacts and fields that will fail

tasks.task: Check OCR text against the original

items.when: When a scanner app has made text from a scan and the values must be checked
When key facts must be pulled from a scan and each checked against its page
When the image is hard to read and needs clean-up before the text is trusted
When a figure matters, to reach it by a second route and compare the two

tasks.task: Map the client's columns to a target system's import template

items.when: When columns must map to Xero, QuickBooks, HubSpot, Shopify or a booking system
When each source column needs a target, a format rule and a decision on gaps
When the import is part of a move between tools and needs checks and a rollback
When the file must be saved in the exact format and encoding the system accepts

tasks.task: Check a file before it is imported

items.when: When a CSV or sheet is ready and must pass the target system's rules first time
When you need blanks, duplicates and odd values listed with the rules that catch them
When spacing, numbers stored as text and mixed dates must be fixed before import
When the file should be fixed and rechecked until it passes, with the rules saved

tasks.task: Prove an entered batch matches its source documents

items.when: Before anyone imports or relies on a batch, to sample it and check control totals
When entered rows can be matched to a source list, to find missing and doubled rows
When the client wants one score per batch for blanks, duplicates and broken links

tasks.task: Write the exceptions list and questions for the client

items.when: When unclear or missing values need listing with the source text quoted
Before the batch counts as done, to get the client's signed review of open items
When the same exception keeps coming back, to trace it to where the record is made

tasks.task: Write a one-page data entry rules sheet for a team

items.when: When dates, names, addresses, phones, money and codes need one agreed way
When several people enter the same records differently and mistakes repeat
When the same record lives in two tools, to set which tool owns each field
When the rules need a flow, who does what and the edge cases written out

tasks.task: Build an entry form or sheet with dropdowns and checks

items.when: When each rule should become a check or dropdown on the sheet itself
When staff enter into Excel and need dropdowns, clear cells and validation
When a web form that logs rows would stop errors better than a shared sheet
When the field list is agreed and you need a formatted empty file with no made-up rows
When people keep typing the wrong thing, to change the form so the mistake is hard to make
When the form is built, to check it and leave a guide for whoever maintains it

tasks.task: Plan and clear a backlog of paper or PDF records

items.when: When months of unentered records must be entered by a date
When the client asks how long it will take, to give time estimates with ranges
When the estimate feels hopeful, to correct it by how such jobs really went

tasks.task: Find duplicate records before or after entry

items.when: When records must be matched across tools with keys, scores and a review step
When the list is a Shopify store's customers and likely doubles need a review list
When a new file may repeat records the system already holds

tasks.task: Enter or tidy a product list for a shop import

items.when: When a supplier's list must fit the shop's product import template
When product titles are inconsistent and need one tidy pattern with a before and after
When the catalogue should be checked monthly for missing costs and clashing codes

tasks.task: Enter and check timesheets before payroll

items.when: When hours must be totalled by person with every oddity flagged for approval
Before the cut-off, to list exceptions and questions against the source files

tasks.task: Enter a stock count and trace mismatches

items.when: When counts are entered regularly and need a schedule and a way to trace mismatches
When the count differs from the system, to split timing, unit and counting errors

tasks.task: Collect listed facts from web pages into a sheet

items.when: When tables, lists or prices on given pages must become a CSV
When a collected fact will be relied on, to check it against a trusted source

tasks.task: Type up recordings and handwritten notes

items.when: When audio or video must be written out with each speaker labelled
When notes are photographed and the text must be read before it is typed up
When the typed text is ready, to catch typos and names spelt two ways

tasks.task: Remove personal details before files are shared

items.when: When names or numbers in a PDF must be redacted with the original kept safe
When a screenshot shows phone numbers, emails or IDs that must be masked first

tasks.task: Write the entry procedure and exception guide

items.when: When the entry job needs a written procedure with who does what
When you have one real run and its exceptions and someone else takes over
When one repeat task needs exact steps, fixes if it fails and who to call
When the firm has several procedures and each should pass a written check

tasks.task: Spot entry work that should be automated

items.when: When the same entry repeats, to lay it out as a no-code automation with what can break
When a small script would do the job better than a no-code tool
When a form, inbox or sheet should pass rows to another app without retyping

always.when: Before any batch, when the target system, columns or formats are not stated
Before a file is imported or relied on, to get a named person's sign-off

helpers.when: When entered bills and receipts must be coded, reconciled to the bank and closed
When invoices need approval rules, payment runs or supplier statement checks
When the system needs a data dictionary, weekly quality checks or a duplicate merge plan
When the entry sheet needs formulas, lookups or macros beyond dropdowns
When repeat entry should be replaced by a form, a sync or an automation
When a CRM import needs pipeline stages, owners and lead routing set, not only contacts

gaps: No library item turns pasted invoices, forms or order emails into rows in a client's own column layout with an exceptions list; only the kit does
No library item turns business card text into CRM contacts
No library item knows the import templates of Xero, QuickBooks, HubSpot or Shopify field by field
No library item checks OCR text for commonly misread characters and digits against the original
No library item sets a spot-sample size and an acceptable error rate for an entered batch
No library item writes a data entry rules sheet for dates, names, addresses and phone numbers by country
No library item plans a backlog clear-down: volumes per day, batch order and progress checks
No library item compares two people's entry of the same batch to find keying errors
No library item reads handwritten forms and marks uncertain characters
The library is thin for this role: about 50 items fit, and most support checking and clean-up, not the entry itself
